notes: Auras a rotation condition names that a talent gives, not a spell of their own: talents.json lists the talent's own spell id, so an auraIsKnown or auraIsActive gate on the aura cannot find its talent through it. Per class, aura spell id -> the talent's spell id (talents.json ranks[].spell_id). Read by data/pipeline/talent_levels.py (a card row gated on the aura starts where the published build takes the talent) and sim/request's ladder (the zero-points exemption for an aura the engine registers only with the talent). Each row says where the engine or the client ties the aura to the talent.

mage.why: Arcane Blast's buff: sim/mage/arcane_blast.go registerArcaneBlastSpell returns before RegisterAura unless Talents.ArcaneBlast.
Fingers of Frost's buff: sim/mage/fingers_of_frost.go applyFingersOfFrost returns before RegisterAura when Talents.FingersOfFrost == 0.
Winter's Chill debuff: sim/mage/talents.go applyWintersChill returns before it builds the debuff array when Talents.WintersChill == 0.
Missile Barrage's buff: sim/mage/missile_barrage.go returns before it registers the buff when Talents.MissileBarrage == 0.
Heating Up's buff: sim/mage/heating_up.go returns before it registers the buff unless Talents.HeatingUp.

Improved Scorch debuff (12873; talents.json lists only the rank-1 id 11095): the debuff (sim/core/debuffs.go ImprovedScorchAura, 12873) exists only through sim/mage/talents.go applyImprovedScorch, which returns when Talents.ImprovedScorch == 0.

shaman.why: Clearcasting: Elemental Focus (16164) procs it (client tooltip: a 10% chance to enter a Clearcasting state); sim/shaman/talents.go applyElementalFocus returns before RegisterAura unless Talents.ElementalFocus.
